label: Higher when belief favors S2; at D1 up after a2-rare-S1, down after a1-rare-S2, up after reward.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_action - prev_state) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 10 (near 1 at D2, lower at D1, dropping late in episode). Beyond timing, at D1 and GO it rises as the ideal observer belief favors S2 (negative weight on belief_lo) and, at D1, strongly depends on the last transition: rare a2->S1 raises it (~+0.19), rare a1->S2 lowers it (~-0.3), common trials near zero; a rewarded last trial raises it. D2 is nearly flat. The free fit adds the reward two trials back at D1 (runs of unrewarded trials keep it low), a separate prev_action==2 effect at GO, and phase-specific belief weights (dev 0.60 vs 0.54 short). Uses no future variables or model outputs.

issues: The belief and transition claims hold up. Dropping the reward term still leaves test R^2 0.506 against 0.526 with it. Restricting belief to D1 only gives 0.401, which confirms belief matters at both D1 and GO. The profile residuals agree: D1 after a2-S1 is about +0.19 and after a1-S2 about -0.26 to -0.35.

'Up after reward' is the weakest part of the short form and is mis-shaped. (phase==D1)*(prev_reward==1) adds only +0.020 test R^2 (weight +0.046). The real effect is a drop after two unrewarded trials in a row: (phase==D1)*((prev_reward==0) & (tv('reward',-2)==0)) has weight -0.176 and lifts test R^2 to 0.563 (with tv('reward',-2)!=1 it is 0.566). The free fit's own tv('reward',-2) term already pointed this way.
The explanation calls the a1-rare (-0.3) and a2-rare (+0.19) effects asymmetric. The short form cannot show that, because prev_action - prev_state fits one symmetric weight of about +/-0.19.

Misses on the original short form show systematic errors. D1 is over-predicted after a1 S2 r, a1 S1 u and a2 S1 u (about -0.08 to -0.09), and GO is under-predicted after a2 (about +0.08). With the revised form the D1 errors shrink to about +/-0.06, but a GO prev_action effect of about +/-0.06 remains. Adding a GO prev_action==2 term in place of the reward term did not help (test 0.516).
skeptic.revised_label: Higher when belief favors S2; at D1 up after a2-rare-S1, down after a1-rare-S2 or two straight losses.
